scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:frontend: npm --prefix galym_frontend run lint && npm --prefix galym_frontend run format:check
scripts.lint:backend: docker run --rm -v ./galym_community:/app -v galym_m2:/root/.m2 -w /app maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21 mvn -q -B spotless:check checkstyle:check
scripts.format: npm run format:frontend && npm run format:backend
scripts.format:backend: docker run --rm -v ./galym_community:/app -v galym_m2:/root/.m2 -w /app maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21 mvn -q -B spotless:apply
